findings.claim: In FilterView.tsx, inside rules.map(...), the 'grafana' branch renders <GrafanaRuleListItem> without key={key>. The sibling branches (DataSourceRuleLoader, UnknownRuleListItem) and the removed GrafanaRuleLoader pass the key.

verifier.reason: In public/app/features/alerting/unified/rule-list/FilterView.tsx:155-163, the 'grafana' branch inside rules.map renders <GrafanaRuleListItem> without passing key={key}, even though key is destructured on line 152 and computed via getGrafanaRuleKey (lines 197-210). Both sibling branches pass key={key} to <DataSourceRuleLoader> (line 165) and <UnknownRuleListItem> (line 169).

findings.claim: useIsRuleEditable calls featureDiscoveryApi.endpoints.discoverDsFeatures.useQuery() before checking whether rule is undefined.

verifier.reason: In public/app/features/alerting/unified/hooks/useIsRuleEditable.ts:23-25, useIsRuleEditable unconditionally calls featureDiscoveryApi.endpoints.discoverDsFeatures.useQuery({ rulesSourceName }) without skipToken or skip, only checking if (!rule) later at line 43 (after checking error at line 33). The patch exposes this path because public/app/features/alerting/unified/rule-list/components/RuleActionsButtons.V2.tsx:52 and public/app/features/alerting/unified/components/rule-viewer/AlertRuleMenu.tsx:53 now call useRulerRuleAbility/useRulerRuleAbilities (and thus public/app/features/alerting/unified/hooks/useAbilities.ts:237) with rule undefined for Grafana list items.
